title: Perihelion folder visibility checkpoint
content:
Perihelion can already hide folders globally by naming them with a leading dot, but true account-aware folder visibility is not wired yet.

What worked:

  • Blunt folder hiding already exists: the backend only lists visible names, so dot-prefixed folders stay out of the normal browser view.
  • Auth and membership checks already exist: Perihelion has the right account scaffolding in place to support more selective folder rules later.

What did not exist yet:

  • No folder-level ACLs: there is no visibility flag or folder permission table yet.
  • No account-based folder filtering: the current listing path does not hide folders by role or username.

The suggested next step was to add a simple folder visibility field first, likely something like public, approved, admin, or hidden, and only move to user-specific folder permissions if the project actually needs that extra control.
